notes: Measured 2026-11-18: max_tokens is capped at 131072; thinking cannot be turned off; prompt caching is implicit.
glm-5.3 is text only: images pasted into a prompt are dropped and the model invents a description. Use glm-5.3-flash for images.
Use a Coding Plan key. The Responses API is at /api/v1, not /api/coding/paas/v4.
Measured 2026-11-18/19: 262144 context; cache_control works; effort is validated by LiteLLM and xhigh clearly thinks longer.
CHATDNP_BASE_URL is the proxy base URL without /v1. It is not in this file because the repository is public.

Measured 2026-11-19 on the hosted API: only /v1/chat/completions works. /v1/responses is not served, and /v1/messages exists but answers 'model not found' for every model, so claude_wrapper and codex_wrapper cannot use this endpoint.
Kimi K3.1 Pro: 1048576 context (from /v1/models); tools and images work; reasoning_effort accepts low/medium/high/max (minimal and xhigh give HTTP 400), and low thinks clearly less than medium/high.

Nemotron 3.5 Super VL: tools and images work; it accepts every reasoning_effort but showed no measurable effect, so effort is not sent. Its context size is not reported: 131072 is a conservative value.
max_output 32768 is a chosen value; the API accepts up to 1048576. Concurrent requests get HTTP 429 (rate limit).

Self-hosted NIM containers also serve /v1/messages and /v1/responses (docs.nvidia.com/nim/large-language-models/latest/reference/api-reference.html). Add one as a separate endpoint with its own URL to use claude_wrapper and codex_wrapper.
